PDF.js 6.3.289, vendored from the official `pdfjs-dist` npm package.

Includes build/pdf.mjs, build/pdf.worker.mjs, cmaps, standard_fonts, wasm,
package.json and the upstream Apache-2.0 LICENSE. No CDN request is required.

Pinned install used: `npm install --ignore-scripts pdfjs-dist@6.3.289`.
Reference API: https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/examples/
